market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $120 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI at ~$107-110 on April 30, 2026, briefly touched $111 amid Iran/Hormuz crisis. To reach $120 intraday in May = ~10% move. Goldman warns of $120 risk; Brent already $118. With ongoing Hormuz blockade, probability is meaningful. Market 0.455 looks roughly fair.
